new.brief: Creates an expression that looks up a property.
new.md:
Creates an expression that looks up a property.

The object to use is found by evaluating the `expression`,
or using the `this` argument when `expression` is `NULL`.

If the resulting object conforms to `this_type`, its property named
`property_name` will be queried. Otherwise, this expression's
evaluation will fail.

The given `this_type` must have a property with `property_name`.

new_for_pspec.brief: Creates an expression that looks up a property.
new_for_pspec.md:
Creates an expression that looks up a property.

The object to use is found by evaluating the `expression`,
or using the `this` argument when `expression` is `NULL`.

If the resulting object conforms to `this_type`, its
property specified by `pspec` will be queried.
Otherwise, this expression's evaluation will fail.

get_expression.brief: Gets the expression specifying the object of a property expression.
get_expression.md:
Gets the expression specifying the object of
a property expression.

get_pspec.brief: Gets the `GParamSpec` specifying the property of a property expression.
get_pspec.md:
Gets the `GParamSpec` specifying the property of
a property expression.
